scope: Independent saved-grid reconstruction, exact six-episode training replay and prospective FT6 engineering release-policy decision. No new 180-cell attempt and no score, fixture or threshold tuning.

training_replay.completion: Unchanged accepted _finish; six consecutive paid native n routes. Replay baseline and journal snapshots must exactly bind every history event's journal counts, hashes and paid-element deltas in the saved first independent-use checkpoint. The audit imports no executor or scheduler.
training_replay.window: Exactly the latest six completed training episodes; unique DCNH cell requires at least four of six. Fewer than six, tied counts, unpaid or incomplete records never establish stabilization.

independent_grid_audit: Read all exact archive member hashes. Decode 228 ordered U2 records, preserving native transactions and C6 episode structures. Rebuild histories and zero-history controls from exact saved row checkpoints. Accepted independent grid/choice/paid-episode auditors must reconstruct every row and identity, not trust summaries. Compare accepted archive protocol and source-freeze hashes against the prepared unchanged source; only separately registered FT6.3b additions are allowed.

decision.causal: For each non-null policy, at least one of H0-H5 must choose differently from both exact history-removal and feedback-off controls; actual paid completion and its element binding must be independently reconstructed.
decision.stabilization: The same unique training n-pair must occupy at least four of all six held-out completed paid n episodes under independent-use history. Reconstruct primary occupancy and all counterexample history cells, including null, supported, failed, no-use and fixed bias.
decision.changed_response: Compare independent-use success-decay-v1 with success-v1 on C4 and C5 by actual chosen identity. Exactly four registered idle turns precede C4. Report all twelve changed decisions and the fixed-bias comparator; no new rate, horizon or threshold.
decision.selection: Apply unchanged FT6.3a selection_rule_for_ft6_3b: success-decay-v1 if causal and stabilization gates pass and at least one C4-C5 choice differs from success-v1; otherwise success-v1 if causal and stabilization pass; otherwise null and held FT6 behavioral gate.
decision.publication: Engineering conditioning policy only. Record no subtype assignment; full intended subtype claim, TD6/TD7 and theoretical C/D registers remain open. A passing engineering decision permits FT7 under the existing hypothesis contract; it never elects an author interpretation.

invariants: No accepted source, legacy-r4 default, TIM, native semantic/payment law, load-v1 reserve, certificate or H.retained changes.
Decision and independent auditor reconstruct choices and occupancy separately; auditors import no runtime selector/executor/scheduler or decision module.
No previously held attempt is relabeled; all 15 history-policy cells and all 48 controls remain accounted for.
Synthetic adversarial records verify decision logic only and never substitute for actual paid causal evidence.
gate: Twelve exact registered methods pass, source matches the preregistered freeze throughout the one bounded evaluation, all accepted input/member/source hashes match, all 228 saved records independently reconstruct, six exact paid training replays reconstruct and bind every saved independent-use history event, 255 predecessor identities remain exact, and the decision and independent audit agree with the unchanged prospective selection rule. A null selection is a held behavioral result rather than acceptance.
